chunks: Then his Lord chose him and placed him among the upright.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean for God to choose someone and make them among the righteous?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as evidence for the divine selection (Istibqa) and infallibility (Ismah) of the Prophet Muhammad, emphasizing that his elevation to the status of the righteous was a result of God's specific choice rather than mere human effort. It underscores the concept of divine grace (Fadl) preceding human merit, a key theme in understanding the spiritual hierarchy of the Ahl al-Bayt.
